name: Reusable password reset token
description:
A password reset token remains valid after it has been used: the same token reset the test identity's password twice. Anyone who later obtains the token, from browser history, a shared computer, proxy or server logs, or a Referer header, can reset the password again.

burpsy reports this when two uses of one fresh token both succeed while the same confirm request with random tokens of the same shape fails.

This row is burpsy's own: Burp's issue catalogue has no password-reset rows.
remediation: Invalidate a reset token when it is used, and invalidate every outstanding token for the account when its password changes.

references.title: OWASP WSTG: Testing for Weak Password Change or Reset Functionalities (WSTG-ATHN-09)

vulnerabilityClassifications.title: CWE-640: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password
